sourceTitle: The Story of Nelson also "The Grateful Indian", "The Boatswain's Son"
description: "The Story of Nelson" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a collection of short stories written in the late 19th century. The foremost tale centers around Lord Horatio Nelson, exploring his life and adventures at sea as recounted by a character who admired him, weaving together historical elements with a personal narrative.
